sourceSentences: Shyvana's basic attacks on-hit will reduce Emberstrike's current cooldown by 0.5 seconds
Emberstrike can be cast twice in Human Form and thrice in Dragon's Descent. Each cast empowers Shyvana's next basic attack within 6 seconds to have an uncancellable windup
After 1.5 seconds of using an Emberstrike attack, or immediately following a basic attack, the ability can be recast within and up to the next 4 seconds each time, before it incurs its cooldown.
Dragon's Descent Bonus - Third Cast: Shyvana takes a bite out of the target, dealing true damage.
Spell shield will not block any damage nor be consumed by the strikes.
Shyvana shields herself for 2.5 seconds, with the shield strength increased by 30% for every nearby enemy champion.
After 1 second, Inferno Aegis can be recast while the shield holds and does so automatically after it expires or is broken.
If the explosion hits an enemy champion, Shyvana heals herself
The fireball is wider, can pass through enemies, and deals increased damage. Upon hitting an enemy champion or large monster, and after reaching maximum range, the fireball sets an explosion
Molten Burst will also scorch the ground it touches beneath

Shyvana transforms into Dragon Form and flies with displacement immunity to the target location, breathing fire in a cone along the way that deals magic damage to enemies hit and fears them for 0.75 seconds
Dragon's Descent's displacement immunity begins from the start of the cast time.
Shyvana transforms into her Dragon Form, becoming Unstoppable, and flying to the target location

After 1.5 seconds of using the empowered attack or immediately after using a basic attack, Shyvana will be able to recast her Q for the next 4 seconds. So, what this means is that auto weaving is going to be extremely important on reworked Shyvana.
time to auto Q auto Q for max DPS.
there's a really cool combo where you can use an auto Q E auto and then Q. This will be the max DPS skirmish combo
Shyvana has really good dragon and baron secure because of the fact her Q3 in dragon form deals true damage. So, if you can combo your Q3 in dragon form with smite
For combos, start W into an attack, Q, and E. Follow up with an attack into your second Q before attacking away.
And your all in is to ult behind your opponent to fear them into danger. From here, E into your W before following up with an attack into Q three times in a row for massive damage.
While in Dragon Form, the explosion will heal her if it strikes an enemy champion.
In Dragon Form, it passes through and explodes upon striking large enemies, leaving behind a trail of fire.
